name: Spider, Massive, Spitter
body:
Massive Spitter Spider
CR 4

XP 1,200
N Large vermin
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +4 natural, -1 size)
hp 37 (5d8+15)
Fort +7, Ref +4, Will +1
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft.
Melee bite +7 (1d8+7 plus poison)
Ranged poison spit +5 (poison)
Special Attacks web (+5 ranged, DC 19, hp 2)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

STR 20, Dex 16, Con 16, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 1
Base Attack +3; CMB +9, CMD 22 (34 vs. trip)
Skills Climb +21, Perception +4 (+8 in webs), Stealth +2 (+6 in webs); Racial Modifiers +4 Perception (+8 in webs), +4 Stealth (+8 in webs), +16 Climb

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite or Spit-contact or injury; save Fort DC 17; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Constitution and 1d2 Dexterity damage; cure 2 consecutive saves.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold forests and mountains, underground
Organization solitary, pair, or colony (1 massive plus 2-8 giant)
Treasure incidental

This spider towers over its peers after it drops from its hiding spot above you.

The spitter spider uses their ability to spit their debilitating poison to aid in their hunting when away from their webs. The cold climates they hail from mean that few creatures are to be found passing through their webs and the prey must be hunted and brought to the webs. Like all giant spiders, the giant spitter spider has a +2 racial bonus on poison save DCs.
